description.en: Hand selected text to Lumo.app to translate, polish, or summarize. Provider, API key, model, and language are all configured in the app's settings.
description.zh-Hans: 把选中文字交给 Lumo.app 处理（翻译 / 润色 / 总结）。Provider、API Key、模型、语言都在 app 的设置里配置。

description.en: Which Lumo build to launch: 'lumo' for the release app, 'lumo-dev' for the dev build.
description.zh-Hans: 启动哪个 Lumo 版本：'lumo' 为正式版，'lumo-dev' 为开发版。
